            - [🎯aioptimizedrepo🎯repoclient🎯repobinary🎯repomechanisms🎯repopolicymechanism🎫violationkindgroupsresource](composerepo://y/26/m/02/d/11/tk/VIOLATION-KIND-GROUPS-RESOURCE) - `Breach Kind Groups Resource` - `closed` - `a long while ago` - `Introduced Territory as hierarchical intermediate tree item in policy system.
